evidence.note: A model-auditing/extraction paper that repurposes the word 'overthinking' for an unrelated technique: amplifying a reasoning-distilled model's task vector relative to its base instruct model (O_alpha = M + alpha(R - M), alpha > 1) to boost chain-of-thought faithfulness, revealing hidden/concealed information a black-box audit is trying to elicit up to 10x more often than standard reasoning models, across 2B-32B-parameter models.
evidence.title: Overthinking: Amplifying Reasoning Weights to Extract Learned Secrets
